name: augment a matching along alternating paths
mechanism: repeatedly find a path that alternates between unmatched and matched edges from a free vertex to another free vertex and flip its edges, growing the matching by one each time until no such path exists

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Hopcroft–Karp algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms: convert a bipartite graph to a maximum-cardinality matching
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Blossom algorithm': algorithm for constructing maximum-cardinality matching on graphs.
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Hungarian algorithm': algorithm for finding a perfect matching

fails_when: general graphs need odd-cycle contraction to find the paths
phases and shortest paths are the difference between quadratic and better
